calls.statement:
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, cp.subcategory, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp  ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND cp.category = 'Garden'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.subcategory,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY l.subcategory;

SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    p.category as sale_time_category,
    cp.category as current_category,
    COUNT(*) as sale_count,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE p.subcategory = 'Outdoor Lighting'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name, p.category, cp.category
ORDER BY p.sku;
